OpenAI corrects GPT-6.2 billing mistake; Astra limits hit 40% faster

OpenAI says it corrected a billing mistake from the launch of its GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol models. The error had incorrectly discounted usage. Astra users will now hit their usage limits up to 40% faster.

Reported by TechRadar; Techmeme. Written by AI.
